description: Accept, tentatively accept or decline the calendar invitation a received message carries, by its msg_ ID. Stores the answer on the mailbox calendar and replies to the organizer only when the organizer sent the message. The message.received webhook's invitation field says which messages carry one.

id.description: msg_ ID of a received message that carries a calendar invitation.

name: shipmail_respond_to_invitation

replied.description: Whether a reply reached the organizer. It is sent only when the organizer is the message's sender.

title: Respond To Invitation
